name: fragreel-steam-gc-sidecar
description: Steam Game Coordinator sidecar bot for FragReel — runs inside FragReel.exe, handles match history + sharecode resolution. Spawned as child process of Python parent via IPC stdin/stdout JSON-line protocol. Uses node-steam-user + node-globaloffensive (DoctorMcKay libs, mar/2026 last release with CS2 support).
